checkpoints.description: Task 'iris-cycle-09' completed successfully.
[1/4] Audio pass 2: make the sound toggle stop already-scheduled voices immediately, proven by a mute-during-cue unit test and a browser stop-log run

impact_assessment.why: setMuted(true) only blocks future play() calls. A cue that is already scheduled keeps sounding, so toggling sound off during the win arpeggio or a hint ping does not silence it.
impact_assessment.benefits: The Sound on/off control takes effect immediately: every active oscillator is stopped and disconnected when muting, while unmuting leaves future cues untouched. No audio file or network change.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: generated audio only; dependency: none; concurrency: one Set of active voices per audio instance; state: no save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Track each oscillator/amplifier pair, remove it on ended, stop and disconnect all voices on mute, guard against double-stop, and test with the fake AudioContext plus a browser stop log.

checkpoints.description: Task 'iris-cycle-10' completed successfully.
[1/4] UI readability pass 4: explain the receiver ring and dot in the symbol key and make the emitter swatch arrow legible, with 1440/390 help pairs

impact_assessment.why: The symbol key says only that a receiver wants one exact hue. The board actually draws the target as the ring and the incoming color as the center dot, which is the one convention the key does not explain. The emitter swatch arrow is also hard to see at normal size.
impact_assessment.benefits: A first-time player can read the receiver state from the glyph after one look, and the emitter direction is visible in the key without zooming; no runtime or save change.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: static help copy and CSS only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the explanation in the receiver label, enlarge the swatch arrow without changing the board glyphs, add a failing-first copy test, and re-check 1440/390 overflow.

impact_assessment.benefits: Leaving the board for the title, chamber index, another level or a reset silences the current cue immediately, while the win dialog itself keeps its fanfare.

impact_assessment.mitigation: Add audio.stop(), call it on the four screen/level transitions, test it with the fake context, and record the stop graph before and after with the browser recorder.
